_doc: Verkaufs-Playbook je Käufer-Zielgruppe (S1, S2, S4, S5, S9, S12) und Branche der Lead-Firma. needs = was die Firma jetzt wahrscheinlich braucht, offer = konkretes Einstiegsangebot, ask = Frage fürs erste Gespräch. Allgemeine Branchenkenntnis, keine Fakten über einzelne Firmen.

needs: CIS returns for subcontractors every month from the first job
VAT registration and the domestic reverse charge on building work
Job costing so they know which contracts actually make money
construction.offer: A CIS and VAT setup package with monthly returns handled, so they can focus on the sites.
construction.ask: Who will run your monthly CIS returns once the first subcontractors start?

needs: VAT registration and a clean record of card and cash takings
Stock valuation and margin tracking from day one
Payroll for the first shop staff
retail.offer: Bookkeeping set up on their till system with monthly VAT and a simple margin report.
retail.ask: How are you tracking takings and stock at the moment?

needs: Payroll for staff with variable hours, tips and tronc
VAT on food and drink, often with mixed rates
Weekly cash-up and supplier invoices under control
hospitality.offer: Payroll and VAT for hospitality, including tips, ready before the first busy weekend.
hospitality.ask: Who is running payroll and tips for your team?

needs: Vehicle finance, fuel and maintenance costs recorded correctly
Payroll for drivers with overtime and allowances
VAT on fuel and cross-border work
transport.offer: A monthly package covering driver payroll, VAT and a cost-per-vehicle report.
transport.ask: How are you keeping track of costs per vehicle?

needs: Clean rental accounts per property
Mortgage interest, corporation tax and director's pay planned together
Deadlines for the first company accounts
property.offer: Property company accounts with a simple per-property report and tax planning.
property.ask: Is the company set up to hold the properties, and who is doing the accounts?

needs: Director's pay planned between salary and dividends
VAT registration, often early because of B2B clients
R&D tax relief if they build their own software
tech.offer: A start-up package: director's pay plan, VAT and a quick R&D relief check.
tech.ask: Have you looked at R&D tax relief for the work you are planning?

needs: Director's pay and dividends planned from the first invoice
VAT registration and clean invoicing
Self-assessment for the directors alongside the company accounts
professional.offer: Fixed monthly fee for company accounts, director's pay and personal tax returns in one.
professional.ask: Have you planned how you will pay yourself from the company?

needs: Payroll and pension auto-enrolment for the first staff
Clear records for different income streams
Regulatory costs and insurance tracked
health.offer: Payroll and pension setup for their first hires, plus monthly bookkeeping.
health.ask: When are you planning to take on your first staff?

needs: Bookkeeping and VAT set up correctly from the start
Director's pay planned
First accounts and tax deadlines diarised
services.offer: A fixed-fee starter package: bookkeeping, VAT and a deadline calendar.
services.ask: Who is looking after the books and the first tax filing?

needs: Month-end close, payroll and supplier payments are backing up while the seat is empty
Errors and late filings become a risk when the rest of the team covers
A reliable outside partner can take the work now and stay as backup later
finance.offer: Interim or outsourced bookkeeping and payroll from next week, until the role is filled.
finance.ask: Who is covering month-end and payroll while the role is open?

needs: Public and employers' liability before the first site
Contractors' all risks and tools cover
Vehicle cover for vans
construction.offer: A contractor package that is ready before they sign their first job.
construction.ask: Do your first contracts already ask for proof of liability cover?

needs: Stock and contents cover
Public liability for customers on the premises
Business interruption if the shop has to close
retail.offer: A shop policy covering stock, premises and liability in one.
retail.ask: Is your stock insured from the day it arrives?

needs: Public and product liability for food and drink
Employers' liability for staff
Equipment breakdown and business interruption
hospitality.offer: A hospitality policy that meets licensing and landlord requirements.
hospitality.ask: Does your lease or licence require specific cover before opening?

needs: Fleet and goods-in-transit cover
Employers' liability for drivers
Cover for hired-in vehicles
transport.offer: A fleet and goods-in-transit quote that grows with each vehicle.
transport.ask: How many vehicles will you run in the first year?

needs: Landlord and buildings cover per property
Property owners' liability
Loss of rent cover
property.offer: A portfolio landlord policy instead of separate policies per property.
property.ask: How many properties will the company hold at the start?

needs: Professional indemnity for client work
Cyber cover for data and systems
Equipment cover for staff laptops
tech.offer: Professional indemnity and cyber cover sized for their first contracts.
tech.ask: Do your client contracts ask for professional indemnity cover?

needs: Professional indemnity
Public liability for client meetings
Cyber cover for client data
professional.offer: A professional indemnity policy matched to their client contracts.
professional.ask: What level of indemnity do your clients expect?

needs: Medical malpractice or treatment risks cover
Employers' liability for staff
Public liability for patients or clients
health.offer: A combined policy for treatment risks, staff and premises.
health.ask: Which regulator or body sets your insurance requirements?

needs: Public and employers' liability
Cover for equipment
Professional indemnity where they advise clients
services.offer: A small-business package with the covers they legally need.
services.ask: Have you put employers' and public liability in place yet?

needs: A website with project photos to win tenders and private jobs
Google Business Profile and local search
Simple quote-request form
construction.offer: A project-portfolio website with a quote form, live within weeks.
construction.ask: Where do your enquiries come from at the moment?

needs: An online shop or click-and-collect
Local search so people find the shop
Opening hours and offers that are easy to update
retail.offer: A shop website with local search setup and optional online store.
retail.ask: Do you want customers to be able to order online?

needs: Online booking and menus
Google Maps and review presence
Photos that sell the place
hospitality.offer: A booking-ready website with menu, photos and Google profile setup.
hospitality.ask: How do guests book a table today?

needs: A professional site for B2B customers
Quote or booking requests online
Trust signals: fleet, coverage, accreditations
transport.offer: A B2B website with an online quote form and coverage map.
transport.ask: How do new customers request a quote?

needs: Property listings with good photos
Lead capture for tenants or buyers
A brand that looks established
property.offer: A listings website with enquiry capture and a clean brand.
property.ask: Where are you advertising your properties right now?

needs: A credible site that explains the product
Landing pages for campaigns
Fast, modern tech stack
tech.offer: A product website with landing pages they can run campaigns on.
tech.ask: What should visitors do first on your website?

needs: A site that builds trust: team, services, credentials
Contact and booking for consultations
Content that ranks for their services
professional.offer: A professional website with booking and service pages that rank.
professional.ask: How do potential clients find you today?

needs: Online appointment booking
Clear services and prices
Local search and reviews
health.offer: A practice website with online booking and local SEO.

needs: A professional website from day one
Google Business Profile
A simple enquiry form
services.offer: A starter website with Google profile setup, live in two weeks.
services.ask: Do you have a website yet, or is it on the list?

needs: New sales people need leads and a website that converts
Marketing material has to keep up with the growing team
Online enquiries take pressure off the sales team
sales.offer: A website refresh with lead capture that supports the new sales hires.
sales.ask: How many enquiries does the website bring in each month?

needs: Workplace pension for site staff
Key-person and director protection
Tax-efficient director's pay and pension contributions
construction.offer: A workplace pension setup plus a director protection review.
construction.ask: Have you set up the workplace pension for your first staff?

needs: Auto-enrolment for shop staff
Business protection if an owner falls ill
Owner's own pension planning
retail.offer: Auto-enrolment setup and a short owner protection review.
retail.ask: Who is setting up the staff pension?

needs: Auto-enrolment for staff with variable hours
Key-person cover
Owner's retirement planning
hospitality.offer: A pension scheme that handles variable hours without admin headaches.
hospitality.ask: How are you handling pensions for staff on variable hours?

needs: Workplace pension for drivers
Key-person and loan protection for vehicle finance
Director's pension contributions
transport.offer: Workplace pension plus protection for the vehicle finance.
transport.ask: Is any of your vehicle finance personally guaranteed?

needs: Director's pension contributions as a tax-efficient extraction
Protection for mortgages
Long-term wealth planning
property.offer: A director's pension and mortgage protection plan.
property.ask: Have you planned how you will take money out of the property company?

needs: Employee benefits to attract talent
Share schemes and pension for founders
Key-person cover for founders
tech.offer: A benefits package that helps them hire, plus founder protection.
tech.ask: What benefits are you planning to offer new hires?

needs: Director's pension contributions
Relevant life and income protection
Staff pension as they grow
professional.offer: A tax-efficient pension and protection plan for the directors.
professional.ask: Have you looked at paying into a pension through the company?

needs: Workplace pension for clinical staff
Income protection for practitioners
Practice succession planning
health.offer: Practice pension setup and income protection for the owners.
health.ask: What happens to the practice income if you cannot work for a few months?

needs: Workplace pension
Director protection
Tax-efficient pension contributions
services.offer: A short review of pension and protection for the directors.
services.ask: Is a pension for yourself and your staff already set up?

needs: Finance roles stay open because good candidates are already employed
Month-end and payroll work piles up while the seat is empty
Interim cover is often needed before a permanent hire
finance.offer: Two or three pre-screened finance candidates within a week, plus an interim option.
finance.ask: How is the finance work being covered while the role is open?

needs: IT candidates get several offers and move fast
Projects stall without the hire
A clear salary benchmark helps close faster
tech.offer: A shortlist with salary benchmark within a week, contingent fee.
tech.ask: Which project is waiting on this hire?

needs: Every week without the salesperson is lost revenue
They need people who can ramp up quickly
Commission structure affects who applies
sales.offer: Candidates with proven sales in their sector, interviews within ten days.
sales.ask: What revenue target is this role carrying?

needs: Skilled trades are scarce and rarely apply online
Work gets turned away without the people
Temporary cover keeps jobs running
trades.offer: Temporary tradespeople this week and a permanent search in parallel.
trades.ask: Are you turning work away because of the open roles?

needs: Care and health roles have high turnover
Rotas depend on filling shifts
Compliance checks slow down hiring
care.offer: Pre-checked candidates and temporary shift cover while they recruit.
care.ask: How many shifts are you covering with overtime right now?

needs: Front and kitchen staff are hard to keep
Busy periods need extra hands fast
Short notice is normal
hospitality.offer: Temporary staff for the next weekends and permanent candidates in parallel.
hospitality.ask: Which shifts are hardest to fill?

needs: Drivers and warehouse staff are in short supply
Missed deliveries cost customers
Seasonal peaks need temporary staff
logistics.offer: Licensed drivers and warehouse staff on short notice.
logistics.ask: Do you have peaks coming up that need extra staff?

needs: The role has been open longer than planned
The team is covering the gap with overtime
They need a faster route to candidates
general.offer: A shortlist of pre-screened candidates within a week, contingent fee.
general.ask: What has made this role hard to fill so far?

needs: First hires decide how fast the company can start trading
Founders rarely have time to screen candidates
A good first team member stays for years
new_incorporation.offer: Help with the first two or three hires, fixed fee per placement.
new_incorporation.ask: Who is the first person you need to hire?

needs: A Google Business Profile with project photos and reviews
Local search visibility for their trade
A simple way to turn searches into quote requests
construction.offer: Local search setup with a review routine and a quote-request page.
construction.ask: Where do your enquiries come from at the moment?

needs: Being found on Google Maps and local search
Social posts that bring people into the shop
Reviews that build trust with new customers
retail.offer: Local search and social media setup to bring more people through the door.
retail.ask: How do new customers hear about the shop today?

needs: Google Maps presence, photos and reviews
Social media that fills quiet days
Online booking or a menu people can find
hospitality.offer: A local visibility package: Google profile, reviews and social posts.
hospitality.ask: How do most new guests find you?

needs: Being found by B2B customers searching for transport
A profile that shows coverage and reliability
Quote requests from search, not only referrals
transport.offer: B2B search visibility with a quote-request page and listings.
transport.ask: How do new customers request a quote today?

needs: Visibility for listings beyond the big portals
Lead capture for tenants, buyers or sellers
A brand that looks established online
property.offer: Local search and lead capture for listings and valuations.
property.ask: Where do your new instructions come from right now?

needs: Search visibility for what the product does
Landing pages and campaigns that convert
Content that explains the product simply
tech.offer: A search and campaign setup with landing pages they can measure.
tech.ask: How do potential customers find you today?

needs: Ranking for their services in local search
Reviews and a profile that build trust
A steady flow of consultation requests
professional.offer: Local SEO and a review routine that bring in consultation requests.
professional.ask: How do potential clients find you today?

needs: Local search and Google Maps visibility
Reviews that reassure new patients
Online booking that people can find
health.offer: Local visibility for the practice: Google profile, reviews and booking.
health.ask: How do new patients find the practice?

needs: A Google Business Profile and local search presence
Reviews that build trust
A simple online presence that brings enquiries
services.offer: A starter local marketing package: Google profile, reviews and a simple online presence.
services.ask: How do new customers find you at the moment?

needs: New sales people need a steady flow of leads
Campaigns that keep up with a growing team
Online enquiries that take pressure off sales
sales.offer: Lead generation campaigns that support the new sales hires.
sales.ask: How many enquiries come in online each month?
